001package com.streamConverter.web;
002
003import com.streamConverter.StreamConverter;
004import com.streamConverter.command.IStreamCommand;
005import com.streamConverter.command.impl.CsvNavigateCommand;
006import com.streamConverter.command.impl.JsonNavigateCommand;
007import com.streamConverter.command.impl.SampleStreamCommand;
008import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
009import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
010import java.io.IOException;
011import java.util.List;
012import org.slf4j.Logger;
013import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
014import org.springframework.core.io.buffer.DataBuffer;
015import org.springframework.core.io.buffer.DefaultDataBufferFactory;
016import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
017import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
018import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
019import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
020import reactor.core.publisher.Flux;
021import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
022
023/**
024 * Web API controller for StreamConverter processing.
025 *
026 * <p>Provides REST endpoints to process data streams using existing StreamConverter functionality.
027 */
028@RestController
029@RequestMapping("/api/v1/stream")
030public class StreamProcessingController {
031
032  private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(StreamProcessingController.class);
033
034  /**
035   * Process data stream with CSV extraction.
036   *
037   * @param inputData binary input data
038   * @param columnName CSV column name to extract
039   * @return processed data as binary stream
040   */
041  @PostMapping(
042      value = "/csv/extract",
043      consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE,
044      produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE)
045  public Mono<ResponseEntity<Flux<DataBuffer>>> processCsvExtraction(
046      @RequestBody Flux<DataBuffer> inputData, @RequestParam String columnName) {
047
048    log.info("Processing CSV extraction for column: {}", columnName);
049
050    return inputData
051        .collectList()
052        .map(this::combineDataBuffers)
053        .map(data -> processWithStreamConverter(data, CsvNavigateCommand.extractOnly(columnName)))
054        .map(result -> ResponseEntity.ok(createDataBufferFlux(result)))
055        .onErrorReturn(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
056  }
057
058  /**
059   * Process data stream with JSON path extraction.
060   *
061   * @param inputData binary input data
062   * @param jsonPath JSON path expression
063   * @return processed data as binary stream
064   */
065  @PostMapping(
066      value = "/json/extract",
067      consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE,
068      produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE)
069  public Mono<ResponseEntity<Flux<DataBuffer>>> processJsonExtraction(
070      @RequestBody Flux<DataBuffer> inputData, @RequestParam String jsonPath) {
071
072    log.info("Processing JSON extraction for path: {}", jsonPath);
073
074    return inputData
075        .collectList()
076        .map(this::combineDataBuffers)
077        .map(data -> processWithStreamConverter(data, JsonNavigateCommand.extractOnly(jsonPath)))
078        .map(result -> ResponseEntity.ok(createDataBufferFlux(result)))
079        .onErrorReturn(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
080  }
081
082  /**
083   * Process data stream with custom command pipeline.
084   *
085   * @param inputData binary input data
086   * @param pipelineConfig pipeline configuration header
087   * @return processed data as binary stream
088   */
089  @PostMapping(
090      value = "/process",
091      consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE,
092      produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE)
093  public Mono<ResponseEntity<Flux<DataBuffer>>> processWithPipeline(
094      @RequestBody Flux<DataBuffer> inputData,
095      @RequestHeader("X-Pipeline-Config") String pipelineConfig) {
096
097    log.info("Processing with pipeline config: {}", pipelineConfig);
098
099    return inputData
100        .collectList()
101        .map(this::combineDataBuffers)
102        .map(data -> processWithStreamConverter(data, buildPipelineFromConfig(pipelineConfig)))
103        .map(result -> ResponseEntity.ok(createDataBufferFlux(result)))
104        .onErrorReturn(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
105  }
106
107  /**
108   * Health check endpoint.
109   *
110   * @return simple health status
111   */
112  @GetMapping("/health")
113  public Mono<ResponseEntity<String>> health() {
114    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.ok("StreamConverter Web API is running"));
115  }
116
117  /**
118   * Combines multiple DataBuffer objects into a single byte array.
119   *
120   * @param dataBuffers list of data buffers
121   * @return combined byte array
122   */
123  private byte[] combineDataBuffers(List<DataBuffer> dataBuffers) {
124    try (ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
125      for (DataBuffer buffer : dataBuffers) {
126        byte[] bytes = new byte[buffer.readableByteCount()];
127        buffer.read(bytes);
128        outputStream.write(bytes);
129      }
130      return outputStream.toByteArray();
131    } catch (IOException e) {
132      log.error("Error combining data buffers", e);
133      throw new RuntimeException("Failed to combine input data", e);
134    }
135  }
136
137  /**
138   * Processes data using StreamConverter with given commands.
139   *
140   * @param inputData input byte array
141   * @param commands stream commands to execute
142   * @return processed output byte array
143   */
144  private byte[] processWithStreamConverter(byte[] inputData, IStreamCommand... commands) {
145    try (ByteArrayInputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(inputData);
146        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
147
148      StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(commands);
149      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
150
151      return outputStream.toByteArray();
152
153    } catch (IOException e) {
154      log.error("Error processing with StreamConverter", e);
155      throw new RuntimeException("Stream processing failed", e);
156    }
157  }
158
159  /**
160   * Creates a Flux of DataBuffer from byte array.
161   *
162   * @param data byte array to convert
163   * @return Flux of DataBuffer
164   */
165  private Flux<DataBuffer> createDataBufferFlux(byte[] data) {
166    DataBuffer buffer = new DefaultDataBufferFactory().wrap(data);
167    return Flux.just(buffer);
168  }
169
170  /**
171   * Builds a pipeline from configuration string.
172   *
173   * @param config pipeline configuration (e.g., "csv:name,json:$.result,process:validator")
174   * @return array of stream commands
175   */
176  private IStreamCommand[] buildPipelineFromConfig(String config) {
177    String[] commandConfigs = config.split(",");
178    IStreamCommand[] commands = new IStreamCommand[commandConfigs.length];
179
180    for (int i = 0; i < commandConfigs.length; i++) {
181      String[] parts = commandConfigs[i].split(":", 2);
182      String commandType = parts[0].trim();
183      String parameter = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1].trim() : "";
184
185      commands[i] =
186          switch (commandType.toLowerCase()) {
187            case "csv" -> CsvNavigateCommand.extractOnly(parameter);
188            case "json" -> JsonNavigateCommand.extractOnly(parameter);
189            case "process" -> new SampleStreamCommand(parameter);
190            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown command type: " + commandType);
191          };
192    }
193
194    log.info("Built pipeline with {} commands", commands.length);
195    return commands;
196  }
197}
